newsitem.title: UK: Saudi reduces May crudes to Asia by 10-20 cents.
newsitem.headline: Saudi reduces May crudes to Asia by 10-20 cents.

text.p: Saudi Aramco on Wednesday informed Asian customers of a 10-20 cent reduction in crude contract prices for May purchases.
Aramco told Asian buyers that Arab Light for May would be priced at Oman/Dubai average plus 50 cents, down 10 cents from April.
Arab Medium and Arab Heavy also were reduced by 10 cents to Oman/Dubai less 50 cents and Oman/Dubai less $1.35 respectively.
Berri extra light was cut by 20 cents to Oman/Dubai plus $1.50 a barrel.
All prices are free on board (fob) Ras Tanura.
